profile.silhouette: goose: heavy low feather barrel, tall curved neck, small rounded head and broad flat bill, short articulated legs, webbed feet and long folded wings
profile.locomotion: alternating short-legged waddling walk; faster longer running steps with lowered neck and brief suspension
profile.attack: authored braced neck lunge and snapping bite, guided by native grazing neck and jaw articulation; no native combat action

bounds.source: bind hierarchy plus opaque plate envelopes

geometry.closure: every member and connector is a closed opaque shape; connector gaskets bridge continuous core masses

compositingPolicy.sortWithinGroup: camera-relative depth, far-to-near, then stable ID
compositingPolicy.bilateralSwap: absolute left/right plates are assigned near/far from projected camera depth at each heading
